notes.title: Announcing two new Frictional Games bundles!
notes.content:
We just launched TWO new Frictional Games bundles on Steam!

These are curated for you who would like to explore more of the same themes - without having to buy all games at once. Two bundles with focus on Frictional's most favorite things - stories and horror.

Frictional Survival Horror Collection:
A collection of the most Survival Horror heavy Frictional Games titles. Put your brave face on and embrace terror.

Bundle includes:
 Penumbra Collectors Pack
 Amnesia: The Dark Descent
 Amnesia: The Bunker

Frictional Story-Rich Collection
A selected collection for you who enjoy tales of psychological horror and existential dread. 

Bundle includes:
 Amnesia: A Machine For Pigs
 SOMA
 Amnesia: Rebirth
Buy these bundles and get an extra 15% off!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/41033/Frictional_Survival_Horror_Collection/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/41032/Frictional_Story_Rich_Collection/
